culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: On customary land, the custom gesture (geste coutumier) is how you introduce yourself and ask permission to enter a tribe: present yourself to the chief or petit chef, explain why you have come, and offer a small present (the common tradition is a 500 franc note and a piece of cloth, manou, but a coffee packet, cap or speciality from home is fine). It is not needed if you have booked a tribal stay (accueil en tribu). (No RBA rate for XPF; at the Institut d'émission d'outre-mer rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA EUR rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 75.0954 XPF: 500 franc ≈ A$6.66)
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Ask before visiting any place on customary land; the gesture serves as the request to enter.
culture-and-protocol.note: Territory-wide guidance applied to the province.
